Introduction

Apink is a South Korean girl group formed by IST Entertainment (then known as Plan A Entertainment in 2011). The group consists of Park Chorong, Yoon Bomi, Jung Eunji, Kim Namjoo, and Oh Hayoung. Hong Yookyung left the group in April 2013 to focus on her studies. Son NaEun left the group in April 2022 to focus on her acting career.

Apink made their official debut on April 19, 2011, with the mini album, Seven Springs of Apink, along with the title track "I Don't Know". In October 2014, Apink released their first Japanese single, "NoNoNo". The group has won awards at shows such as the 26th Golden Disc Awards, 21st Seoul Music Awards, and 13th Mnet Asian Music Awards. Their first music program win was on M Countdown on January 5, 2012, for "My My" from their second mini-album Snow Pink.

On May 2, 2025 it was announced that IST Entertainment's exclusive contract with Eunji would be ending after 14 years. Shortly after that announcement, Eunji revealed that she had signed an exclusive contract with the agency BILLIONS. She has also stated that she will continue being a member of Apink. Following Eunji's departure, all members of Apink have left IST Entertainment.
